ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a schematic diagram of changes in the proportion of land area occupied by various urban functional zones within a range of 4 kilometers from the city center of a certain megacity. <image1> What type of functional zone does 2 in the figure represent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is time, from 1980 to 1990 and around 2000, and the vertical axis is the proportion of land area occupied. Each functional zone is represented by different filled bands. Number 2 is located in the middle of the figure and is the area filled with vertical dashed lines; around 1980, it occupied a relatively large proportion, and afterward it clearly shrank as time passed, leaving only a relatively small proportion after 2000. Then reason: this figure shows the changes in land-use proportions of various functional zones within 4 kilometers of the city center of a certain megacity. Near the center of a megacity, land prices rise and environmental requirements increase, so original industrial land often migrates to the urban periphery. Therefore, the proportion of industrial-zone land near the center will continue to decline. The changing characteristics of 2 in the figure exactly conform to the pattern of industrial zones moving outward and their proportion decreasing, so 2 represents an industrial zone.

The changing characteristics of 2 in the figure exactly conform to the pattern of industrial zones moving outward and their proportion decreasing, so 2 represents an industrial zone.
